confirmed_and_fixed_findings.finding: Inspect accepted a same-bytes foreign replacement after completed rollback.
confirmed_and_fixed_findings.correction: Require the recorded restored file identity as well as preimage bytes for ownership and clean rollback inspection.

confirmed_and_fixed_findings.finding: A changed restore temporary could be moved into the target.
confirmed_and_fixed_findings.correction: Recheck restore temporary size/hash and its original file identity immediately before replacement.

confirmed_and_fixed_findings.finding: A foreign same-preimage replacement during rollback could be recorded as owned restoration.
confirmed_and_fixed_findings.correction: Bind restored destination identity to the verified restore temporary; report ambiguous on mismatch.

confirmed_and_fixed_findings.finding: Corruption after a durable write_intent could precede a target write.
confirmed_and_fixed_findings.correction: Revalidate journal path/identity/chain immediately before each apply or rollback replacement.

scope_choices: Windows-only apply; dry-run and inspection are read-only
Existing regular allowed source files only; no addition/deletion or metadata/ACL-preservation claim
Out-of-band exact raw-plan hash required; this binds a plan but does not authorize deployment
No CLI and no live updater/service/admission integration
Existing journals refuse apply; inspect never resumes or restores
Cooperating calls serialize through a Global target-identity mutex; arbitrary external races remain outside an atomic guarantee
File fsync and replacement are bounded safeguards, not a promise of power-loss directory durability
Automatic rollback is limited to own still-matching postimage identity and bytes; journal, backups and temporary artifacts are retained
